headline: Enquire About a Crewed Charter
primaryText: Somewhere between the Cyclades and the Ionian is a bay only a handful of Vernicos Yachts captains know how to find. This season, getting there costs a little less.
whyItWorks: It opens with a secret, hard-to-reach bay, which sparks curiosity and sells the dream of an exclusive trip before any price talk. The discount is held back to a soft line at the end of the copy and then shown plainly on the image as 'up to 15% off', which gives a reason to enquire now. The photo of a yacht in clear turquoise water backs up the promise, and the ad is only a few weeks old, so there is no long-run signal yet.
